programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: James returns home to his native Yorkshire, where he is joined by good friend and multi award-winning chef Brian Turner. They both visit the Windermere Jetty Museum, and are treated to a trip out on Lake Windermere on a traditional steam-powered boat.

programme.desc: James continues his British adventure by taking to the seas and travelling across the Solent to explore the Isle of Wight with Hampshire chef Lenny Carr-Roberts. Lenny takes a trip to the other side of the island in search of James' favourite sausage roll, made by WW Woodford and Sons Butchers in Bembridge.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: James' culinary adventure hits the South West of England with a visit to the food capital of this region, the vibrant city of Bristol. Their first stop is Wapping Wharf, a series of shipping containers housing everything from a butcher to a cheese-monger. After a bit of shopping, James pitches up his mobile kitchen overlooking the iconic Clifton Suspension Bridge to make a tagine of lamb chops.

After a team of potential players has been recruited, former player Jimmy Dugan coaches the girls and prepares them for the World Series.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. He follows three rules: do not hurt anybody, do not steal from anyone who does not deserve it, and play the game like you have got nothing to lose. With those in mind, Danny works to orchestrate the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history, targeting three establishments owned by the man who is dating his ex-wife.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After pulling off their Las Vegas casino heist, Danny Ocean incurs the wrath of Terry Benedict, who wants his money back with interest. Lacking the cash to meet his two-week deadline, the crew of thieves must plan an elaborate robbery in Europe, or their lives will be forfeit. While they have Danny's wife on their side, they face a new challenge in the form of the mysterious 'Night Fox', who seems to be the better thief.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: The remaining members of Danny Ocean's gang regroup to jeopardise the nefarious plans of a businessman who double-crossed one of Danny's old friends. The team plans to ruin the opening of his glitzy Las Vegas casino and hotel by rigging the games and ensuring that every punter goes home with a jackpot.
